name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Text field with a suggestion list: static data or async loading, highlighted matches and full keyboard support.
improvements: No XSS: matches are highlighted with React nodes, never innerHTML (Materialize CVE-2019-11003), and image URLs are scheme-checked.
Implements the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern: role=combobox, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant and a listbox of options, plus a live result count.
Async loadOptions(query, signal) with debounce, AbortController cancellation and loading/empty states.
The list is portalled and positioned with Floating UI (flip, shift, size), so it is never clipped by overflow containers or modals.
Arrow keys, Home/End, Enter and Escape work; controlled and uncontrolled values.
